description: Updates the active status for multiple harm sources in a single request.

id.description: Unique identifier of the harm source.

name.description: Display name of the harm source, translated to the requested locale. For the untranslated original name, see name_key.

name_key.description: Untranslated original name of the harm source. Use for programmatic matching when locale-independent identification is needed.

active.description: Whether this harm source is active and available for selection when recording incidents.

global.description: Whether this harm source is a Procore-provided default. Global harm sources cannot be renamed or deleted.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this harm source was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this harm source was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

harm_source.description: Harm source identifiers and the active status to apply.

items.description: Unique identifier of a harm source to update.

active.description: Whether the specified harm sources should be active (available for selection) or inactive.
